Name: Riot Rank Tracker
Author: Packrat

Actions.Name: LoL Rank
Actions.Tooltip: Your current League of Legends ranked tier, division and LP, with how much it has moved since yesterday or this week. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: TFT Rank
Actions.Tooltip: Your current Teamfight Tactics ranked tier, division and LP, with how much it has moved since yesterday or this week. Press to refresh.

Description: Your own League of Legends and TFT rank on your deck, updating on its own while you play or stream. No alt-tabbing to the client to check LP. Bring your own personal Riot API key. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Riot Games, League of Legends, or Teamfight Tactics.
